# Whisper speech model

The release includes quantized ONNX weights derived from OpenAI Whisper Small, distributed under Apache License 2.0.

- Original model: https://huggingface.co/openai/whisper-small
- ONNX conversion: https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/whisper-small
- Pinned revision: `36050c46d777d46dc4b5f43f6d90574fc38f8732`
- License: [Apache 2.0](Apache-2.0.txt)

The file checksums and source revision are recorded in `scripts/speech-model.json`. The ONNX community supplies converted/quantized weights; daddyloop does not modify those weights. Node packages retain their own license files.
